decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 3.	The proposed development would result in a building that would be excessively bulky to the extent that it would have a cramped appearance to the detriment of the character of the area, would be likely to result in unreasonable overlooking of neighbouring residential premises and would unreasonably obstruct light to and outlook from neighbouring premises.  The development would therefore be contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1. (New Development and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Council's Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - 4.	The proposed development would result in dwellings that would not meet Council standards with respect to car parking and the provision of a reasonable level or outdoor amenity space.  The development would therefore be contrary to policies H.4.1 (Housing Standards), T.1.4 (Car Parking) and ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) of the Council's Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a two storey addition to convert existing bungalow into three self contained flats.
